newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Davids leaves supemarket lobby group.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Davids leaves supemarket lobby group.

text.p: Food wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd said on Tuesday it had resigned from the Australian Supermarket Institute (ASI) because the organisation was biased towards the major distributors.

"The ASI had promoted in recent years a number of causes which increasingly advantaged the national market chains to the disadvantage of the independent retailers of Australia," Davids executive chairman John David said.
"Davids can no longer be associated with the Australian Supermarket Institute and its promotion of causes which are putting independent retailers out of business across Australia," he said.

"Davids has always been the champion of the independents and the time has come for us to take a stand against governments and statutory bodies on various issues on behalf of the Independents," he said, citing the company's opposition to deregulated trading hours and industry changes which would hurt small pharmacists and newsagents, among other things.
National grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd on Monday announced plans to enter the wholesale market and, in effect, challenge the dominant position of Davids.
The other major national food and grocery retailer is Coles Myer Ltd.
